Careers

# Build AI that actuallyfinishes the work.

We are a small team working on a hard problem: replacing the manual loop that keeps enterprise documents from reaching the systems that need them. If you want your work to have a direct line to production and customers, this is the place.

[View open roles](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/nanonets)

How we work

## Small team, real ownership.

We are a lean team that ships production software used by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including a third of the Fortune 500. Every person here owns something that matters and is responsible for seeing it through.

We do not hire for roles where the work is unclear. If you join, you will know exactly what you are responsible for and how it connects to customers. We value judgment over credentials, and shipping over planning.

Values

## How we operate.

No DMs — share everything.

No silos, no secrets. If it matters, it goes in the open. We default to transparency so everyone can move fast with full context.

131 — metrics over everything.

We measure what matters and let the numbers tell the truth. Gut feel is a starting point, not a conclusion.

Everyone annotates.

No job is beneath you. "That's not my job" can't be uttered here. We roll up our sleeves at every level.

Activate the customer.

Delighting customers is our only job. Everything else is a means to that end.

It's time to build.

We are home to builders who love creating — the crazy ones, the misfits, the rebels, the troublemakers who don't fit in elsewhere.

Maldives or nothing.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards. If we can't go big, we'd rather not go at all.

Team

## We travel together.

Offsites are how we step back from the day-to-day, build trust, and think bigger. We have done them in Hanoi, Bangkok, the Maldives, and Tokyo.

Benefits

## Comprehensive coverage, from day one.

United StatesIndia

Medical

Comprehensive health coverage through Blue Shield of California and Kaiser. Company covers the majority of premiums.

Dental

Choice of carriers including Aetna, Delta Dental, Guardian, and MetLife. Full preventive care coverage.

Vision

Coverage through Aetna EyeMed or VSP Vision. Low exam copays and a generous frames and contacts allowance.

Life & Disability

Company-paid basic life and AD&D, with options to buy supplemental coverage for you and your family. Short- and long-term disability plans included.

FSA & HSA

Pre-tax Health Care FSA, Dependent Day Care FSA, and HSA. HSA balances roll over year to year — no use-it-or-lose-it.

Commuter Benefits

Pre-tax transit and parking through HealthEquity to reduce your taxable income.

Employee Assistance

Confidential support through AllOne Health — counselling, family support, substance abuse resources, and retirement planning, available around the clock.

Voluntary Benefits

Supplemental coverage from Aflac, Farmers GroupSelect, MetLife, and IdentityForce at group rates — accident, critical illness, auto, home, legal, pet, and identity protection.

## See it run on your process.

From AI-native hypergrowth companies to Fortune 500 enterprises,

Nanonets automates business processes so teams can focus on what matters.
